_meta.description: Training Ground ILM council seat → protector template mapping

seats.coaching_copy: The steady center that can hold the whole council without becoming any single part.
A part of you may be managing boundaries and assessing threats from a leadership seat — in IFS this maps to a manager role (not a firefighter).
A part of you may be trying to anticipate and control outcomes before pain arrives.
A part of you may be working to keep harmony — sometimes at the cost of your own voice.
A part of you may be holding high standards — notice whether it protects or punishes.

language_rule: Say 'a part of you is carrying the ___ role' — never 'you are the ___.'
